summary: GIBO Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that, effective September 15, 2026, independent directors Ms. Bee Lian Ooi and Ms. Li Noi Chia resigned from the board and their respective committees. The company stated neither resignation stemmed from any disagreement over operations, policies, or practices. The board simultaneously appointed Ms. You Shim Ban and Ms. Yi Theng Teh as independent directors, restoring the board to five members. Committee roles were reassigned; Ms. Teh chairs audit and qualifies as an audit committee financial expert. As a foreign private issuer, this maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. What to watch: whether further governance turnover or strategic changes follow this abrupt, simultaneous board reshuffle.
